objects.name: typewriter
objects.description: black/dark-brown manual typewriter; only moving object. Starts in the air at top centre (partly cut by image top in frames 0-1), falls ~vertically onto the desk behind the front paper sheet, tumbles/rocks (rear lifts, frames 11-18) and comes to rest at frame ~23 between back paper/keys and the red alarm clock.
objects.reference_point: ref_x, ref_y = bounding-box centre (proxy for object origin/centre)
objects.apparent_size: bbox width ~290-297 px during the whole fall (frames 0-9, nearly constant -> roughly constant depth); bbox height grows 116 (f2) -> 168 (f9) as it rotates/is seen more from above; at rest bbox 277 x 172 px (x 1095-1371, y 524-695), mask major axis 286 px at -167 deg, minor 161 px
objects.occlusion: never occluded by other objects; it occludes the back paper/keys and part of the red alarm clock when at rest
